spec.name: Furniture Witch Hat Stack
spec.description: Three crooked, stepped witch hats stacked into one compact furniture piece: burnt orange below plum and charcoal, with broad square brims, brass buckles and a small brass spider resting on the upper brim. Floor-standing, axis-aligned geometry stays inside the block with a 0.25-unit outer margin.

prompt: Create an original vanilla Minecraft furniture model: three crooked stepped witch hats piled together, black, plum purple and burnt orange fabric, broad square brims, brass buckles and a small spider ornament. Grounded attractive survival-server furniture. Entire model fits x=0..16, y=0..16, z=0..16; floor y=0, front negative Z. 16 units per Minecraft block. Standing on floor y=0. Keep a 0.25-unit margin at outer x/z edges.  Use 8-30 purposeful axis-aligned cuboids, no rotations, no bones, no animation. Detailed hand-painted pixel art, coherent palette, explicit non-overlapping cube-net UVs with correct texel density. Connected physical structure, no z fighting, no stand outside the furniture. No text labels, no surrounding scene. Generate the whole piece with its distinctive silhouette and materials.
